# Author enterprise Grid tutorial (buffered rows, locked columns, header groups, cell editing) in learn/tutorials/

## Context

Sub-issue of `#20498` implementing **Row 6 (`tutorials-missing`)** of the three-reader `learn/` map ([`#20498#issuecomment-6697670393`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20498#issuecomment-6697670393)).

- **Ownership disposition:** `unowned-rationale: claimable leaf under #20498 per map #issuecomment-6697670393 (delegated filing by @neo-fable-mnemosyne)`

## The Problem

`learn/tutorials/` currently holds 6 entries (`RSP.md` `"todo"` stub, `Earthquakes.md` `50 KB` / `1,442`-line monolith, `TodoList.md`, `CreatingAFunctionalButton.md`, `Routing.md`, and `DockLayoutsFirstLayout.md`). Neither the **Developer** reader nor the **Enterprise Evaluator** reader finds a step-by-step tutorial for Neo.mjs's flagship enterprise surface: **`Neo.grid.Container`** (buffered `100,000`-row stores, locked start/end columns, multi-level `header.GroupRow` column groups, and typed cell editing), nor tutorials for reactive forms (`form.Container` + `state.Provider`) or multi-window tear-out workspaces.

Design authority: `#20498` + `#20498#issuecomment-6697670393` (Row 6 `tutorials-missing`) + `.agents/skills/guide-authoring/references/guide-authoring-bar.md` §0–§5.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/grid/` (`38` classes) and `examples/grid/{bigData,lockedColumns,headerGroups,cellEditing}/` prove Neo.mjs's OMT grid architecture in live examples, and `learn/guides/datahandling/GridContainer.md` explains the internals, but `learn/tutorials/` has zero grid tutorials.
- Per `#20498#issuecomment-6697670393` Row 6, the grid tutorial comes first (`100k` rows, locked columns, header groups, cell editing), grounded against `src/grid/Container.mjs`, `src/grid/Body.mjs`, `src/grid/header/GroupRow.mjs`, and `src/grid/plugin/CellEditing.mjs`.

## The Fix

1. Author a step-by-step enterprise Grid tutorial under `learn/tutorials/` (e.g., `learn/tutorials/EnterpriseGrid.md`) and register it in `learn/tree.json` under `Tutorials`:
   - Walk the reader from a record-backed `Neo.data.Store` + `Neo.grid.Container` through **buffered scrolling at scale (`20,000`–`100,000` rows)**, **locked start/end columns (`locked: 'start' | 'end'`)**, **multi-level header groups (`header.GroupRow`)**, and **typed `grid.plugin.CellEditing`**.
   - Include runnable `javascript live-preview` steps and a top-down (`flowchart TD`) Mermaid diagram showing how scroll and cell-edit deltas flow between `App` Worker, `VDom` Worker, and Main Thread (`guide-authoring-bar.md` §3).
2. Verify all `live-preview` blocks and Mermaid diagrams render cleanly in the Portal (`#/learn/tutorials/...`).

## Contract Ledger

| Target surface | Source of authority | Proposed behavior | Fallback / edge case | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `learn/tutorials/` + `learn/tree.json` | `#20498#issuecomment-6697670393` Row 6 + `guide-authoring-bar.md` §0–§5 | Add a step-by-step enterprise Grid tutorial covering buffered rows, locked columns, header groups, and cell editing with runnable `live-preview` blocks and a `TD` Mermaid diagram | Keep pre-Dec-1 confidentiality boundary (`decisions-in-force.md` §2.3: no public mention of private Neo Pro features) | `learn/tutorials/*.md`, `learn/tree.json` | Portal render verification + `node ./buildScripts/util/check-relative-links.mjs` |

Decision Record impact: none.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **AC-1 (Grounding & Structure):** The new Grid tutorial in `learn/tutorials/` is grounded against `src/grid/Container.mjs`, `src/grid/header/GroupRow.mjs`, and `src/grid/plugin/CellEditing.mjs` (`guide-authoring-bar.md` §1–§2) and registered in `learn/tree.json`.
- [ ] **AC-2 (Runnable Live Previews & `TD` Mermaid):** All `javascript live-preview` blocks and the `flowchart TD` diagram render with `0` console/page errors in the Portal.
- [ ] **AC-3 (Link & Whitespace Integrity):** `node ./buildScripts/util/check-relative-links.mjs` and `node ./buildScripts/util/check-whitespace.mjs` pass with `0` errors, and `apps/portal/sitemap.xml` / `apps/portal/llms.txt` are untouched.

## Out of Scope

Naming any private pre-Dec-1 Neo Pro feature (`decisions-in-force.md` §2.3); hand-editing `apps/portal/sitemap.xml` or `apps/portal/llms.txt`.

## Avoided Traps

- Writing reference-manual prose instead of a progressive, runnable build tutorial (`guide-authoring-bar.md` §4).
- Using `LR` Mermaid diagrams that clip horizontally in the Portal reading pane (`guide-authoring-bar.md` §3).
